onset.Description: Marker position (s) from the start of the recording, as stored in the AnyWave marker file

duration.Description: Marker duration (s) as stored in the AnyWave marker file (0 = instantaneous)

trial_type.Description: AnyWave marker label, verbatim (e.g. '43Hz D08-D09 0.6mA; body perception' = 43 Hz stimulation of bipolar contacts D08-D09 at 0.6 mA with the clinical response; 'SPES D08 D09'; prestim/stim/poststim = authors' analysis windows)

value.Description: AnyWave marker value field (n/a when the file stored -1)

targets.Description: AnyWave marker target channels, if any

Levels.analysis_ades_mrk: <recording>.ades.mrk (markers added by the authors for analysis windows)
